metadata.authority_role: Changes the treatment of court-ordered child support paid: effective for budgets completed March 10, 2003, it is excluded from gross income before the 130% gross eligibility test; the memo's separate net-income steps subtract the 20% earned income deduction before child support.
metadata.discovered_via: policyengine-us child support election citations and PR #9622; source retrieved directly from the official publisher
metadata.expression_date_note: Memorandum date printed in its heading, 03/04/03; effective for budgets completed March 10, 2003 and after.
metadata.extraction_note: The memo sits in one table cell, so the whole memo is one block; its in-text headings are bold, underlined text, not heading tags.
metadata.later_history_note: The released Missouri SNAP manual's revision histories for the child support exclusion sections (us-mo/manual/dss/snap/1115-000-00/1115-035-00/1115-035-20 and its subsections) list IM-111 (October 22, 2004), which is not retained here.
metadata.replaced_in_part_by: IM-34 (March 15, 2013), us-mo/guidance/dss/im-2013-34, which replaces this memo's budgeting steps for disqualified or ineligible members.
